sourceInformation.perspective: Fixed-screen side view with orthographic 2.5D graphics
sourceInformation.tech: Three.js r180 (0.180.0), WebGPURenderer with WebGL2 fallback, Rapier 2D 0.19.3, Gamepad API, Web Audio API, PeerJS 1.5.5, AI Hub Session Protocol v1 client 1.4.0
sourceInformation.artDirection: Procedural cel-shaded 3D with ink outlines, teal masonry, copper pipes, and warm paper accents
sourceInformation.animation: Three.js AnimationMixer and AnimationClip keyframe tracks for characters, platforms, bell, and coins; procedural effects
sourceInformation.audio: Original code-synthesized music, effects, and Animalese/Simlish-style gibberish voices; music defaults to 10%
sourceInformation.online: 1–4 player shared-world co-op through AI Hub; standalone PeerJS room codes with BroadcastChannel for nearby tabs; local couch co-op
sourceInformation.testing: 34 automated checks: real Rapier mechanics, full solo and two-bot playthroughs, emulated controller and phone multitouch, OfflineAudioContext, WebGPU pixel readback and recovery, file protocol, local rooms, real WebRTC, and four AI Hub harness scenarios; screenshots for visual review. Physical devices and listening quality: unknown.
sourceInformation.research: No internet research. Native model knowledge for the source. Supplied AI Hub integration files and pinned dependency source files read for implementation.

testingFeedback: 5 confirmed implementation/environment issues: an unsupported toon-material option, the supplied software WebGPU flag combination, premature graphics recovery, browser gestures cancelling the touch stick, and stale gameplay notices on the title screen. A timing-sensitive jump assertion was also corrected.
3 blockers in the affected setup: WebGPU device loss, failed graphics recovery, and cancelled touch movement. All are resolved in the tested paths.

aiHub.name: Flip Bros
aiHub.description: Clock into a cel-shaded sewer caper. Bump platforms to flip pests, kick them into combos, scoop up payday coins, and blow King Clog’s lid across four arcade shifts.
aiHub.controls: Move: stick/D-pad or A D/arrows; jump: Cross/A or Space; dash: Square/X or X/Shift; bell: Triangle/Y or E; pause: Options or Esc. Touch: drag left, tap right, double-tap dash.
